probe_orders: A then B; unpaid contact and a neutral wait occur after the first action
role_of_parent: Frozen parameters and original active local write process. Each life starts cold once.
laws: Independent unbiased signs, sampled separately for every route and never provided to the selector.
B_preservation: Double weight on realized B alone, joint reward, a small fixed fraction deferred, and a prespecified independent paired test of B. Objective is a soft incentive.

rule.proposal_partition: Same-sign surviving native B proposals sorted by magnitude, nonoverlapping consecutive quadruples. Up to three unmatched proposals per sign pass unchanged.
rule.dose: At one of four addresses withhold 75% of the minimum group magnitude, preserving residuals at all four, native writes elsewhere, bias, birth and retirement. Per-group signed dose is constant across selected-address controls, subject only to float32 subtraction roundoff.
rule.old_record: Pre-receipt motor emission endpoint activities and the last actual common-edge coefficient change from A. Node activities are physically stored once per node.
rule.training_update: Sample once from the shared categorical head per valid group. Center actual serial return by a leave-one-route-out mean within birth. Apply the analytical score-function derivative over sampled groups, with Adam on head coefficients.
rule.isolation: Arms use disjoint random streams. No route continuation yields another reward. The native commit helper calculates two neutral ticks while constructing the B receipt; its hidden result is discarded in fitted routes. Only the sampled B write enters either return action. The optimizer sees only realized payoffs and local scores.
